echo_cast.name: 复诵
echo_cast.playerSummary: 按显示比例再次施放已记录的完整技能。
echo_cast.mechanicDetails: 复诵会重新结算该技能的目标与效果，但不会再次消耗法力、不会进入冷却，也不会触发另一次复诵。

repeat_effect.sourceHint: 来源：带有「复现本次效果」说明的专精。

intercept_damage.name: 替代承担
intercept_damage.playerSummary: 队友原本要受到伤害时，由你替它承受显示比例。
intercept_damage.mechanicDetails: 例如替代承担 40%，你承受原伤害的 40%，原目标承受剩余 60%；只会在节点写明的队友与触发条件下生效。
intercept_damage.sourceHint: 来源：并肩承伤、哨卫连结、坚盾援护。

extra_turn.name: 额外行动
extra_turn.playerSummary: 当前事件结算后插入一次完整行动。
extra_turn.mechanicDetails: 额外行动不会改变正常回合顺序；每场战斗指本次进入战斗直至结束、跨所有敌人刷新波次，每波指每次新敌人刷新。
extra_turn.sourceHint: 来源：写明「获得 1 次完整额外行动」的专精。

recognized_debuffs.name: 可识别减益
recognized_debuffs.playerSummary: 这类专精会识别目标身上的普通可见减益。
recognized_debuffs.mechanicDetails: 当前包括观察、重点目标、破绽、锁定、抢先锁定、连击锁定、裂镰创口、暴击破绽与哨卫锁定；它们都显示在单位状态栏，可被驱散，只有效果明确写出时才会消耗。
recognized_debuffs.sourceHint: 来源：查看句中具体减益词条。

observed_gap.name: 观察
observed_gap.playerSummary: 第一次命中目标时留下，第二次命中会消耗。
observed_gap.mechanicDetails: 学习「观察间隙」后首次命中目标获得；再次命中同一目标时消耗并提高本次伤害。
observed_gap.sourceHint: 来源：观察间隙的首次命中。

hunter_mark.name: 重点目标
hunter_mark.playerSummary: 让全队更容易优先选中这个敌人的可驱散减益。
hunter_mark.mechanicDetails: 学习「盯住那个」后，开战时为攻击最高的敌人施加；2 级起每波刷新，后续等级还会扩展选敌规则。

exposed_mark.name: 破绽
exposed_mark.playerSummary: 由伤害技能留下，可被拆增益与延长冷却的效果消耗。
exposed_mark.mechanicDetails: 学习「看见破绽」后，伤害技能命中时施加；持续时间由该节点当前等级决定。

eagle_eye_mark.name: 锁定
eagle_eye_mark.playerSummary: 施加给剩余生命最低敌人的可驱散减益。
eagle_eye_mark.mechanicDetails: 「先看一眼」会在每个新敌人刷新波次开始时施加；「换个目标」会在击败带有该减益的敌人后重新施加。
eagle_eye_mark.sourceHint: 来源：先看一眼、换个目标。

preemptive_mark.name: 抢先锁定
preemptive_mark.playerSummary: 每个敌人刷新波次开始施加的可驱散减益。
preemptive_mark.mechanicDetails: 持有者会被优先选取，且物理、魔法抗性各降低 15 个百分点；写明识别可见减益的效果会识别它。

eagle_volley_mark.name: 连击锁定
eagle_volley_mark.playerSummary: 由每回合第一次多段攻击留下的短时可驱散减益。
eagle_volley_mark.mechanicDetails: 学习「眼疾爪快」后，多段攻击每回合首次造成伤害时施加；持续时间由节点当前等级决定。

sentinel_mark.name: 哨卫锁定
sentinel_mark.playerSummary: 替生命最低的队友承担伤害后，为本次伤害来源施加的可驱散减益。
sentinel_mark.mechanicDetails: 学习「互相照看」后，每回合第一次为生命最低的队友替代承担伤害时施加，持续 2 回合。

combat_rhythm.name: 战斗节律
combat_rhythm.playerSummary: 敏捷路线积累并消耗的节律层数。
combat_rhythm.mechanicDetails: 每施放 1 次非普通攻击技能获得 1 层，最多 3 层；达到 3 层后由节点写明的下一次伤害消耗。

arcane_circuit.name: 奥术回路
arcane_circuit.playerSummary: 施放非普通攻击技能时积累的回路层数。
arcane_circuit.mechanicDetails: 每次施放获得 1 层，最多 3 层；达到 3 层时消耗 3 层并恢复节点写明的法力。

mana_circuit.name: 法力回路
mana_circuit.playerSummary: 连续施放非普通攻击技能时积累的回路层数。
mana_circuit.mechanicDetails: 每次施放获得 1 层，最多 2 层；达到 2 层时消耗 2 层并恢复节点写明的法力。

guard_stance.name: 守势
guard_stance.playerSummary: 承受伤害时积累、用于保护队友的层数。
guard_stance.mechanicDetails: 每承受 1 次伤害获得 1 层，最多 3 层；达到 3 层时消耗 3 层，为生命最低的队友提供节点写明的减伤。

reaper_wound.name: 裂镰创口
reaper_wound.playerSummary: 镰刀撕开的可驱散减益，可被其他专精与装备识别。
reaper_wound.mechanicDetails: 持续 2 回合，物理抗性降低 12 个百分点；除非效果明确写出，否则识别它不会消耗它。

critical_exposure.name: 暴击破绽
critical_exposure.playerSummary: 念珠或镰刀留下的可叠加减益，每层使暴击伤害抵抗降低 5 个百分点。
critical_exposure.mechanicDetails: 最多 6 层，共降低 30 个百分点；每层独立持续 6 回合，可被驱散，念珠与镰刀共享层数上限。

specialization_bow_rhythm.name: 弓弦节拍

specialization_sword_composure.name: 收刀定势

break_momentum.name: Break Momentum
break_momentum.playerSummary: A counter built and spent by the Strength route.
break_momentum.mechanicDetails: After learning Charged Strike, each physical damage event grants 1 stack, up to 2. Only effects that explicitly spend it remove stacks.

echo_cast.name: Echo Cast
echo_cast.playerSummary: Cast a recorded full skill again at the shown effectiveness.
echo_cast.mechanicDetails: An echo resolves the skill's targeting and effects again without spending MP or applying cooldown, and cannot create another echo.

repeat_effect.name: Repeat Effect
repeat_effect.playerSummary: Repeat the current damage or healing event at the shown ratio without recasting the skill.
repeat_effect.mechanicDetails: The repeat keeps the event's target and type and does not dispatch specialization hooks again by default, preventing recursion.
repeat_effect.sourceHint: Source: specializations that explicitly say Repeat this effect.

intercept_damage.name: Intercept
intercept_damage.playerSummary: Take the shown share of damage that was about to hit an ally.
intercept_damage.mechanicDetails: At 40% intercept, you take 40% of the original damage and the original target takes the remaining 60%. It only works for the ally and trigger named by the node.
intercept_damage.sourceHint: Sources: Shared Guard, Sentinel Link, and Resolute Interception.

extra_turn.name: Extra Action
extra_turn.playerSummary: Insert one full action after the current event resolves.
extra_turn.mechanicDetails: An extra action does not change normal turn order. Per battle spans the entire battle across all enemy waves; per wave resets when a new enemy wave appears.
extra_turn.sourceHint: Source: specializations that explicitly grant 1 full extra action.

recognized_debuffs.name: Recognized Debuffs
recognized_debuffs.playerSummary: These specializations recognize ordinary visible debuffs on the target.
recognized_debuffs.mechanicDetails: The current set is Observed, Priority Target, Exposed, Lock On, Preemptive Lock, Volley Lock, Reaper Wound, Critical Exposure, and Sentinel Lock. They appear on unit cards, can be dispelled, and are consumed only when an effect says so.
recognized_debuffs.sourceHint: Source: open the specific inline debuff entry.

observed_gap.name: Observed
observed_gap.playerSummary: Applied on the first hit and spent by the next hit on that target.
observed_gap.mechanicDetails: After learning Ear Radar, the first hit applies it; the next hit consumes it to increase that event's damage.
observed_gap.sourceHint: Source: the first hit from Ear Radar.

hunter_mark.name: Priority Target
hunter_mark.playerSummary: A dispellable debuff that makes the party prefer this enemy.
hunter_mark.mechanicDetails: Watch That One applies it to the highest-Attack enemy at battle start; from rank 2 it refreshes each wave, and later ranks expand its targeting rules.

exposed_mark.name: Exposed
exposed_mark.playerSummary: Applied by damage skills and spent by effects that remove buffs or extend cooldowns.
exposed_mark.mechanicDetails: After learning Spot the Gap, damage skills apply it for the duration set by that node's current rank.

eagle_eye_mark.name: Lock On
eagle_eye_mark.playerSummary: A dispellable debuff applied to the surviving enemy with the lowest HP.
eagle_eye_mark.mechanicDetails: Look First applies it at the start of every enemy wave. Next Target reapplies it after an enemy with this debuff is defeated.
eagle_eye_mark.sourceHint: Sources: Look First and Next Target.

preemptive_mark.name: Preemptive Lock
preemptive_mark.playerSummary: A dispellable debuff applied at each enemy refresh wave.
preemptive_mark.mechanicDetails: Its bearer is prioritized and loses 15 percentage points of physical and magical resistance. Effects that recognize visible debuffs recognize it.

eagle_volley_mark.name: Volley Lock
eagle_volley_mark.playerSummary: A short dispellable debuff applied by the first multi-hit damage event each turn.
eagle_volley_mark.mechanicDetails: After learning Sharp Eyes, Quick Paws, the first multi-hit damage each turn applies it; its duration is set by the node's current rank.

sentinel_mark.name: Sentinel Lock
sentinel_mark.playerSummary: A dispellable debuff applied to the damage source after intercepting damage for the lowest-HP ally.
sentinel_mark.mechanicDetails: Watch Each Other applies it for 2 turns the first time each turn it intercepts damage for the lowest-HP ally.

combat_rhythm.name: Combat Rhythm
combat_rhythm.playerSummary: A counter built and spent by the Dexterity route.
combat_rhythm.mechanicDetails: Each non-basic skill cast grants 1 stack, up to 3. At 3 stacks, the next qualifying damage event spends them as described by the node.

arcane_circuit.name: Arcane Circuit
arcane_circuit.playerSummary: Circuit stacks built by casting non-basic skills.
arcane_circuit.mechanicDetails: Each cast grants 1 stack, up to 3. At 3 stacks, consume all 3 to restore the MP listed by the node.

mana_circuit.name: Mana Circuit
mana_circuit.playerSummary: Circuit stacks built by consecutive non-basic skill casts.
mana_circuit.mechanicDetails: Each cast grants 1 stack, up to 2. At 2 stacks, consume both to restore the MP listed by the node.

guard_stance.name: Guard Stance
guard_stance.playerSummary: Stacks built by taking damage and spent to protect an ally.
guard_stance.mechanicDetails: Each damage event taken grants 1 stack, up to 3. At 3 stacks, consume all 3 to grant the node's listed reduction to the lowest-HP ally.

reaper_wound.name: Reaper Wound
reaper_wound.playerSummary: A dispellable scythe wound recognized by other specializations and equipment.
reaper_wound.mechanicDetails: Lasts 2 turns and reduces physical resistance by 12 percentage points. Recognition does not consume it unless an effect says so.

critical_exposure.name: Critical Exposure
critical_exposure.playerSummary: A stackable debuff left by mind orbs or scythes; each stack reduces Crit Damage Resist by 5 percentage points.
critical_exposure.mechanicDetails: Stacks up to 6 for a total 30-point reduction. Each stack lasts 6 turns independently, can be dispelled, and shares one cap across mind-orb and scythe applications.
critical_exposure.sourceHint: Source: Expose Weakness and Reaper Pursuit.

specialization_bow_rhythm.name: Bowstring Rhythm
specialization_bow_rhythm.playerSummary: A short rhythm earned by a bow or crossbow critical hit: +6 Speed and +12% critical damage.
specialization_bow_rhythm.mechanicDetails: Appears on the unit card and can be dispelled. Its duration is set by the current rank of the node that applies it.

specialization_quick_nock.name: Quick Nock
specialization_quick_nock.playerSummary: A short preparation after a successful hunt: +8 Speed and +5% critical chance.
